TYPE 1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT
Substitute Narrative
2401-07 West Congress Parkway
RT-3.5 District to B2-3 District (Type 1)

4Comers, LLC is the “Applicant” for a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment for the subject property located at 2401-07
West Congress Parkway from the RT-3.5 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District to the B2-3
Neighborhood Mixed-Use District in order to divide the existing improved zoning lot into two zoning lots and convert
the existing four-story institutional building at the subject property for residential use.

The subject property is bounded by West Congress Parkway on the north, South Western Avenue on the east, and
an alley on the south. To the west, the subject property is adjacent to the property commonly known as 2409-11
West Congress Parkway, which is currently improved with a two-story addition to the existing building on the subject
property, a two-story institutional building, and a surface parking lot. The adjacent property and the subject property
are currently a single improved zoning lot. The Applicant proposes to divide the existing zoning lot into two zoning
lots and develop each for residential use. The subject property will be one of the new zoning lots.

The subject property contains approximately 13,104 square feet of site area and is improved with an over 100-year-
old vacant institutional building. The existing building contains approximately 40,532 square feet of floor area and
occupies substantially ail of the site. A two-story building addition that encroaches over the boundary of the new
proposed zoning lot will be demolished. No other changes or additions are proposed to the building envelope.

There are no off-street vehicular parking spaces on site. The subject property is a transit-served location based on
its proximity to the Westem Avenue CTA Blue Line station entrance and the Western Avenue CTA bus line corridor.
The Applicant pians to complete a rehabilitation of the existing building to upgrade aged and substandard
components of the structure and convert the building to residential use. The building will contain a total of 52
residential units (40 efficiency units and 12 dwelling units) and 24 secure bicycle parking spaces. The FAR will be
3.1. The Applicant seeks all relief necessary, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, for the attached plans.
